basic_info.description: New Transparent price! Sun-filled and recently remodeled, this spacious single-family home offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience. Featuring 4 large bedrooms, 4 full baths, and a bonus office space, this nearly 2,000 sq. ft. property is designed for modern living. The brand-new en-suite bathroom adds a touch of luxury to the primary bedroom, while abundant storage throughout ensures everything has its place.    With parking for 4 cars (2 in the large garage and 2 on the driveway), you'll never have to worry about space. The home's location is idealjust a short walk to McLaren Park, one block from Muni, and with quick freeway access, you're only 15 minutes from downtown San Francisco. Offering incredible value in the city, this is a home that checks all the boxes for anyone seeking space, style, and an unbeatable location.
